c. 1947
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
SAINT FELIX FRIARY Route 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
DEAR FRIEND,
Kindly accept our heartfelt thanks for your recent favor, duly received and noted. May our dear Lord reward your charity in, something of "that peace which the world can not give." Incidently; we are asking our friends to join us in, "storming Heaven" for God's blessing on our poor, dear Foreign Missionaries and their charges.
Quite alone in many cases, and far from other Priests, they often meet with unforeseen difficulties of discouragement. They would not be human if failure and con- sequent discouragement did not sometimes weaken their efforts. PRAYER, therefore, on part of friends at home, is of primary importance; -- everything else secondary. Besides: in this, we are only reechoing the divine call to "duty of gratitude" Jesus himself, pleading, -- " ... Pray ye, therefore, the Lord of the harvest; that he send laborers into his harvest."
Gratefully yours in Christ
Capuchin Fathers
